content:
I'll help you add a new ACK-managed S3 bucket for logs following the knr-ops patterns. Let me create the complete set of manifests using kustomize base + overlays structure.

## Directory Structure

```
infra/
  s3-logs/
    base/
      kustomization.yaml
      bucket.yaml
      versioning.yaml
      encryption.yaml
      public-access-block.yaml
    overlays/
      dev/
        kustomization.yaml
        bucket-patch.yaml
      prod/
        kustomization.yaml
        bucket-patch.yaml
infra/
  iam/
    s3-logs-irsa/
      base/
        kustomization.yaml
        role.yaml
        policy.yaml
      overlays/
        dev/
          kustomization.yaml
          role-patch.yaml
        prod/
          kustomization.yaml
          role-patch.yaml
flux/
  kustomizations.yaml (updated)
```

---

## 1. S3 Bucket Base

**`infra/s3-logs/base/bucket.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: myapp-logs
    app.kubernetes.io/component: logs-storage
spec:
  forProvider:
    # region set per-overlay
    forceDestroy: false
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default
```

**`infra/s3-logs/base/versioning.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: BucketVersioning
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-versioning
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucketRef:
      name: myapp-logs
    versioningConfiguration:
      - status: Enabled
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default
```

**`infra/s3-logs/base/encryption.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-encryption
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucketRef:
      name: myapp-logs
    rule:
      - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
          - sseAlgorithm: AES256
        bucketKeyEnabled: true
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default
```

**`infra/s3-logs/base/public-access-block.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-pab
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucketRef:
      name: myapp-logs
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default
```

**`infra/s3-logs/base/kustomization.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - bucket.yaml
  - versioning.yaml
  - encryption.yaml
  - public-access-block.yaml

commonLabels:
  app.kubernetes.io/part-of: myapp
  managed-by: ack
```

---

## 2. S3 Bucket Overlays

**`infra/s3-logs/overlays/dev/bucket-patch.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    # ACK/Crossplane will use metadata.annotations for external name.
    # Bucket name is set via annotation to allow deterministic naming.
    region: us-east-1
```

**`infra/s3-logs/overlays/dev/kustomization.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
namespace: ack-system

resources:
  - ../../base

patches:
  - path: bucket-patch.yaml
    target:
      kind: Bucket
      name: myapp-logs

# Set deterministic external bucket name via annotation
patchesJson6902:
  - target:
      group: s3.aws.upbound.io
      version: v1beta1
      kind: Bucket
      name: myapp-logs
    patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /metadata/annotations
        value:
          crossplane.io/external-name: myapp-logs-dev

commonLabels:
  environment: dev
```

**`infra/s3-logs/overlays/prod/bucket-patch.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1
    forceDestroy: false
```

**`infra/s3-logs/overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
namespace: ack-system

resources:
  - ../../base

patches:
  - path: bucket-patch.yaml
    target:
      kind: Bucket
      name: myapp-logs

patchesJson6902:
  - target:
      group: s3.aws.upbound.io
      version: v1beta1
      kind: Bucket
      name: myapp-logs
    patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /metadata/annotations
        value:
          crossplane.io/external-name: myapp-logs-prod

commonLabels:
  environment: prod
```

---

## 3. IAM Role for IRSA

**`infra/iam/s3-logs-irsa/base/role.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: myapp-logs-irsa
    app.kubernetes.io/component: iam
spec:
  forProvider:
    # assumeRolePolicy (OIDC trust) is patched per-environment
    # because it references the env-specific OIDC provider ARN.
    forceDetachPolicies: true
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default
```

**`infra/iam/s3-logs-irsa/base/policy.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-rw
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: myapp-logs-rw
spec:
  forProvider:
    # policy document patched per-env to scope ARN to the env bucket
    name: myapp-logs-rw
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default
---
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: RolePolicyAttachment
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-attach
spec:
  forProvider:
    policyArnRef:
      name: myapp-logs-rw
    roleRef:
      name: myapp-logs-irsa
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default
```

**`infra/iam/s3-logs-irsa/base/kustomization.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - role.yaml
  - policy.yaml

commonLabels:
  app.kubernetes.io/part-of: myapp
  managed-by: ack
```

**`infra/iam/s3-logs-irsa/overlays/dev/role-patch.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa
spec:
  forProvider:
    assumeRolePolicy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Principal": {
              "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::111122223333:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEV_OIDC_ID"
            },
            "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
            "Condition": {
              "StringEquals": {
                "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEV_OIDC_ID:sub": "system:serviceaccount:myapp:myapp-logs",
                "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEV_OIDC_ID:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
              }
            }
          }
        ]
      }
---
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-rw
spec:
  forProvider:
    policy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Sid": "ListBucket",
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": ["s3:ListBucket", "s3:GetBucketLocation"],
            "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev"
          },
          {
            "Sid": "ReadWriteObjects",
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": [
              "s3:GetObject",
              "s3:PutObject",
              "s3:DeleteObject"
            ],
            "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev/*"
          }
        ]
      }
```

**`infra/iam/s3-logs-irsa/overlays/dev/kustomization.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
namespace: ack-system

resources:
  - ../../base

patches:
  - path: role-patch.yaml

commonLabels:
  environment: dev
```

**`infra/iam/s3-logs-irsa/overlays/prod/role-patch.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa
spec:
  forProvider:
    assumeRolePolicy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Principal": {
              "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::444455556666:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/PROD_OIDC_ID"
            },
            "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
            "Condition": {
              "StringEquals": {
                "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/PROD_OIDC_ID:sub": "system:serviceaccount:myapp:myapp-logs",
                "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/PROD_OIDC_ID:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
              }
            }
          }
        ]
      }
---
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-rw
spec:
  forProvider:
    # least-privilege: explicit actions, no wildcards on prod
    policy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Sid": "ListBucket",
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": ["s3:ListBucket", "s3:GetBucketLocation"],
            "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-prod"
          },
          {
            "Sid": "ReadWriteObjects",
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": [
              "s3:GetObject",
              "s3:PutObject",
              "s3:DeleteObject"
            ],
            "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-prod/*"
          }
        ]

```

```yaml

kind: Kustomization
namespace: ack-system

  - path: role-patch.yaml

```

## 4. Flux Kustomizations (updated)

Add these to **`flux/kustomizations.yaml`**. The `dependsOn` ordering ensures the bucket exists before the IAM policy (which references its ARN) reconciles.

```yaml
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: s3-logs-dev
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  path: ./infra/s3-logs/overlays/dev
  prune: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: flux-system
  wait: true
  timeout: 5m
  dependsOn:
    - name: ack-controllers   # ensure ACK CRDs/controllers are ready
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: s3-logs-irsa-dev
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  path: ./infra/iam/s3-logs-irsa/overlays/dev
  prune: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: flux-system
  wait: true
  timeout: 5m
  dependsOn:
    - name: s3-logs-dev       # bucket must exist before policy scoping
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: s3-logs-prod
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  path: ./infra/s3-logs/overlays/prod
  prune: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: flux-system
  wait: true
  timeout: 5m
  dependsOn:
    - name: ack-controllers
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: s3-logs-irsa-prod
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  path: ./infra/iam/s3-logs-irsa/overlays/prod
  prune: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: flux-system
  wait: true
  timeout: 5m
  dependsOn:
    - name: s3-logs-prod
```

## Notes on Design Decisions

**SOPS usage:** The manifests above contain no plaintext secrets — bucket/IAM configs are non-sensitive. Following the canonical spec, SOPS is reserved for the DB connection string. If you need to reference the OIDC provider IDs or account IDs as secrets, place them in a SOPS-encrypted `ConfigMap`/`Secret` and enable decryption on the Flux Kustomization:

```yaml
spec:
  decryption:
    provider: sops
    secretRef:
      name: sops-age
```

**Acceptance criteria mapping:**

| Requirement | Implemented by |
|---|---|
| Bucket name `myapp-logs-{env}` | `crossplane.io/external-name` annotation per overlay |
| Versioning enabled | `BucketVersioning` (status: Enabled) |
| AES256 encryption | `BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration` |
| No public access | `BucketPublicAccessBlock` (all four flags true) |
| IRSA read/write role | `Role` + `Policy` + `RolePolicyAttachment` with OIDC trust |
| Least privilege, no wildcards on prod | Explicit actions, ARN scoped to env bucket |
| Separate Flux reconciliation | Dedicated `s3-logs-{env}` Kustomizations |
| Environment isolation | Independent overlays + independent Flux Kustomizations |

**Verify before applying:**
```bash
kustomize build infra/s3-logs/overlays/dev
kustomize build infra/s3-logs/overlays/prod
kustomize build infra/iam/s3-logs-irsa/overlays/dev
kustomize build infra/iam/s3-logs-irsa/overlays/prod
```

Would you like me to adjust the API group (e.g., if you're using the AWS-native ACK controllers `s3.services.k8s.aws` instead of the Upbound `s3.aws.upbound.io` group), or wire the IAM policy to reference the bucket ARN dynamically via cross-resource references?
